limitations: This is a selected-source review, not an exhaustive scan of every operator in Japan.

The KEYUCA PR release headline contains a weekday mismatch (Wednesday); its body and the official Aeon Mall Tokushima page both state 2026-11-06 Friday, so the exact date is supported by two consistent detailed sources.
Some broad November-only leads (including すき家 高岡大野店, はま寿司稚内店, and クレーン横丁 極 相模原小山店) still do not have a confirmed exact opening date and were not added.
